title: A failure-class detection (cue) row
description: One machine-readable tripwire. CLOSED: the key set is exactly {engine, pattern, cue_ref}; any undeclared key fails. engine is an enum over the supported set; pattern and cue_ref are non-empty strings. Pattern compilation under its engine is a separate defence-in-depth probe (grep -E), applied by the validator AFTER this schema conformance.
